plain: Pattern detection runs body first: a feeling, then an image of pieces that don't line up, then recognition (somatic marker hypothesis).
research_check: Verified, with a caveat: the somatic marker hypothesis is contested. Dunn, Dalgleish & Lawrence 2006 (Neurosci Biobehav Rev) and Maia & McClelland 2004 (PNAS) found participants knew more consciously than claimed. 'Body first' is a supported reading, not a settled mechanism.
